description:
Rebuilding Damaged Medical Unit of Bai Sakarbai Dinshaw Petit Hospital for Animals
Rtn PP Shailesh Jalan and Rtn Jaimin Dani visited the Bai Sakarbai Dinshaw Petit Hospital for Animals at Parel some time back and saw the urgent need to rebuild their damaged Medical unit, estimated at Rs 10 lakh. The hospital provides essential care to numerous animal species (including Dogs, Cats, Cattles, Horses & Birds) and desperately needed support.
Members were requested to contribute generously and help to make a meaningful difference for the voiceless animals.
Rtn Jaimin Dani Rs 25,000/-, RCMNP Charities Trust Rs 25,000/-, Rtn PP Suraj Saraogi Rs 25,000/-, Rtn PP Hemang Bhatt Rs 25,000/-, Rtn PP Jagdish Tanna Rs 25,000/-, Rtn PP Shailesh Jalan Rs 25,000/-, Rtn Ajay Rs 25,000/-, Rtn Samir Rs 25,000/-, Rtn Sanjiv Rs 25,000/-, Rtn Dhanraj Rs 25,000/-, Rtn Nilesh Rs 25,000/-, Rtn Hemal Rs 25,000/-
Amount collected Rs 3 lakhs and donated to BSDPH for Animals on 23rd October 2026.
